headline: Codacons prices | From utility bills to fuel: autumn squeeze coming, +633 euros per family
summary: Consumer group Codacons expects a squeeze of 633 euros per family this autumn from higher utility bills and fuel costs, citing the current geopolitical situation.
why: Energy and fuel prices drive household inflation, which influences consumer spending and central-bank policy in Italy and the euro area.
